faqs.question: What does the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Urine test measure?
faqs.answer: This test measures the presence of Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex bacteria (MTB) as well as non-tuberculous bacteria or mycobacteria other than tuberculosis (NTM or MOTT) in urine samples.

faqs.question: Why is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Urine test done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex or non-tuberculous bacteria • To determine the effectiveness of treatment for these infections • To monitor the progress of the infection over time • To aid in identifying potential drug resistance in bacteria causing the infection

faqs.question: When is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Urine test recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test may be recommended if you have • Symptoms suggestive of a tuberculosis infection, such as cough, fever, weight loss, and night sweats. • A history of exposure to someone with tuberculosis. • HIV infection or other conditions that weaken your immune system and increase the risk of developing tuberculosis. • A previous diagnosis of tuberculosis and need for monitoring during and after treatment.

faqs.question: What if the results of the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Urine test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate an active tuberculosis infection or other bacterial infections.

faqs.question: What to expect during the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Urine test?
faqs.answer: • A sample of your urine will be collected in a sterile leak-proof container. • The sample will be sent to the laboratory for processing and culture.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Urine test?
faqs.answer: To prepare for this test: • Collect 15 ml of spot urine in a sterile leak-proof container. • There are no specific dietary or medication preparations required for this test. • Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Urine test?
faqs.answer: Other tests that may be ordered alongside the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Urine test include: • Acid-Fast Bacillus (AFB) Smear and Culture: This test helps identify and diagnose tuberculosis and other Mycobacterial infections. • Chest X-ray: To evaluate the presence of any lung abnormalities suggestive of tuberculosis infection. • Complete Blood Count (CBC): To assess overall health status and evaluate any signs of infection.

faqs.question: What is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Urine test also known as?
faqs.answer: Urine Culture for Mycobacterium Tuberculosis Complex and Non-Tuberculosis Bacteria (NTM)

faqs.question: What is tuberculosis?
faqs.answer: Tuberculosis (TB) is a contagious bacterial infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. It primarily affects the lungs but can also affect other parts of the body. TB is spread through the air when an infected person coughs or sneezes, leading to respiratory symptoms and potential complications if left untreated.
